interface.name: soyeht_unadvertised_blur_manager

description.summary: a blur manager that no compositor offers

interface.description: Written for Soyeht from the calls that GPUI makes, not from any compositor's protocol. No compositor advertises this name, so a client that looks for the global finds none and never sends one of these requests.

description.summary: a blur object for a surface
remove the blur of a surface
